newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate edges up, baht firm late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate edges up, baht firm late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate edged up to 7.50-7.75 in late trade from 7.50 in the morning, dealers said.
"The interbank rate is expected to firm slightly tomorrow. But the high overall market liquidity will prevent the rate from rising sharply," said a dealer at a local bank.
Dealers said the liquidity was still high because most banks were maintaining heavy funds ahead of corporate tax payments due later this month. Corporate tax has to be paid bi-monthly.
The baht climbed to 25.268-25.273 against the dollar in late trade compared with 25.276-25.279 in the morning on late dollar selling, dealers said.
The one-month swap premium was steady at 7.00/7.50 satangs late, unchanged from early morning.
The mid-rate was fixed at 25.27 to the dollar versus 25.28 on Monday.
